name: codex-connector-3000
description: A local ChatGPT/Codex bridge for controlled Codex execution, project inspection, session continuation, and provenance-preserving handoffs.

interface.longDescription: A local MCP bridge that lets an authorized host invoke Codex against the configured project, inspect project state, continue Codex sessions, and preserve execution provenance. It never silently grants OS permissions; Codex sandbox and approval settings remain authoritative.
defaultPrompt: Ask local Codex to inspect this project.
Have Codex implement this task and run the tests.
Ask Codex for a project status and verification report.
